sources.observation: The fort follows the exposed ridge above the surrounding field slopes. The long frontier wall extends west along the escarpment.
The open granaries have paired rows of raised floor piers. The low rectangular foundation walls and worn gate jambs follow the hillside.

limitations: Surviving wall crests, the extent of smaller foundations and individual granary supports are approximated from photos and terrain. The terrain elevation follows Terrarium sampling.
